source_evidence: Some annuities include implicit costs that are harder to identify, but also reduce the value of your annuity.
question: Misconception: If an annuity doesn’t show a separate fee, it has no costs.
answer: A lack of a visible, separate fee doesn’t mean there are no costs. Implicit costs may be built into the interest credited or limits on gains, and can reduce your return just as an explicit fee can.
